deleted.sentence: A brilliant, blinding flash follows a whistling sound—a high, thin shriek that cuts the silence, sending a shockwave through the air.
My house is dark in that same moment because I never saw my parents.
I am the only witness who saw it happen, not a clerk.
I remember the geography of that night as a tangled travel plan, a long winding route along the ancient walled city edges flowing north to south.
I was trying to read the wall from one story, a ship of the city walls, seeking a shortcut through the Automatic Reactors district.
The trick was to take the longest-magnified route up north to south, then go east to west through the reactors, then return to read where the reactors were.
I should give you the second-travel-diary.
It was a moment of pure, unfiltered memory, a snapshot of a city that had long since forgotten its past.
